wholePhysicalScope: The 25 native points hold the main building, projected portico and attached galleries. The Natural History Museum is a separate mapped building.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the museum footprint, the projected portico and arches. Near views add mouldings, parapet balusters and window trim.
limitations: The old image establishes the surviving front section. The roof divisions, rear and side elevations, smaller ornamental features and gallery heights are approximate.
The Natural History Museum, freestanding grounds monuments and museum interiors are outside the main-building scope.
